mapper.select: SELECT id, travel_plan_id, created_by_user_id, token_hash, token_encrypted, status, invalidated_at, created_at, updated_at FROM travel_plan_invitations WHERE travel_plan_id = #{travelPlanId} AND status = #{status} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE travel_plan_invitations SET status = #{toStatus}, token_encrypted = NULL, invalidated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE travel_plan_id = #{travelPlanId} AND status = #{fromStatus}
